description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller `PreviewCatalogController` providing stub endpoints for catalog data. These endpoints are used in a preview environment where the catalog service is not running, returning predefined or deterministic dummy data for categories and products. It includes methods for listing categories and products, retrieving specific categories by ID, and getting product details by SKU, all with stub responses suitable for testing or development.

classes.name: PreviewCatalogController
classes.description: A REST controller providing preview stub endpoints for catalog operations in a non-running downstream services environment.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of stubbed categories for a given store ID, adding a custom header indicating stub response.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stub category by ID; if not found, returns a generic placeholder.

methods.name: listProducts
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of stubbed products for a given store ID, with stub response header.

methods.name: getProductBySku
methods.description: Returns detailed stub product information for a given SKU, associated with a store.

methods.name: stubCategoriesFor
methods.description: Helper method producing a list of predefined category responses for a store.

methods.name: stubProductsFor
methods.description: Helper method producing a list of predefined product summaries for a store.

methods.name: paginate
methods.description: Utility method to paginate a list of items considering possibly send 1-based page numbers, returning a `PagedResponse`.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Utility method converting a string into a URL-friendly slug.
